newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy arrives for Israel-PLO summit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy arrives for Israel-PLO summit.

text.p: U.S. Middle East peace envoy Dennis Ross arrived at the Israel-Gaza border on Tuesday for a meeting between Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, witnesses said.

The summit, a bid to close a deal on a long-overdue Israeli troop pullback from the West Bank town of Hebron, was due to begin at 11 a.m. (0900 GMT), but officials said the start of the meeting might be delayed. They did not elaborate.
Israel and the PLO have accused each other of foot-dragging in nearly three months of talks on Hebron, due to have been handed over to the Palestinians months ago.
The sides were cautious on Tuesday on hopes that the two could sign an agreement at the end of the meeting.
"We believe there will be no announcement of an agreement today," a PLO official told Reuters. "The negotiators will continue working until they agree on the remaining issues."
But Arafat's spokesman Marwan Kanafani was quoted by Israel's army radio as saying Netanyahu and Arafat could initial a draft agreement later in the day.
